arguments:
{"code":"local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
  local atk = attacker.atk
  local alevel = attacker.level
  local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0
  local dhp = defender.hp
  local shield = defender.shield or 0
  local armor = defender.armor
  local dlevel = defender.level
  local delement = defender.element
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding or false
  local power = skill.power
  local element = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local true_damage = skill.true_damage or false
  local seed = skill.seed or 0
  local m
  if element == 'physical' then
    if delement == 'ghost' then m = 0 else m = 100 end
  elseif element == 'fire' then
    if delement == 'fire' or delement == 'water' then m = 50
    elseif delement == 'nature' then m = 200
    else m = 100 end
  elseif element == 'water' then
    if delement == 'fire' then m = 200
    elseif delement == 'water' or delement == 'nature' then m = 50
    else m = 100 end
  elseif element == 'nature' then
    if delement == 'water' then m = 200
    elseif delement == 'fire' or delement == 'nature' then m = 50
    else m = 100 end
  else
    m = 100
  end
  local r = resist[element] or 0
  if r < -50 then r = -50 elseif r > 80 then r = 80 end
  local hp = dhp
  local absorbed = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local killed = false
  local k = 1
  while k <= hits and hp > 0 do
    resolved = resolved + 1
    local p = power - 20 * (k - 1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)
    local diff = alevel - dlevel
    if diff < -10 then diff = -10 elseif diff > 10 then diff = 10 end
    d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)
    local crit = (seed + 17 * k) % 100 < crit_chance
    if crit then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
    end
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if crit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
    end
    if not true_damage then
      d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
      d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
    end
    if guarding then
      d = math.floor(d / 2)
    end
    local immune = (not true_damage) and m == 0
    if d < 1 and not immune then d = 1 end
    local a = shield
    if d < a then a = d end
    shield = shield - a
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield == 0 then
      loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100)
    end
    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
    k = k + 1
  end
  return {damage = dhp - hp, absorbed = absorbed, hp = hp, shield = shield, overkill = overkill, crits = crits, hits = resolved, killed = killed}
end
local function fmt(t)
  return string.format('{damage=%d, absorbed=%d, hp=%d, shield=%d, overkill=%d, crits=%d, hits=%d, killed=%s}', t.damage, t.absorbed, t.hp, t.shield, t.overkill, t.crits, t.hits, tostring(t.killed))
end
local R1 = resolve_attack({atk=40, level=12, crit_chance=30, crit_mult=150, pen_pct=25, pen_flat=5}, {hp=60, shield=10, armor=40, level=10, element='nature', resist={fire=20}, guarding=false}, {power=120, element='fire', hits=2, true_damage=false, seed=3})
local R2 = resolve_attack({atk=90, level=3, crit_chance=50, crit_mult=200, pen_pct=40, pen_flat=10}, {hp=300, shield=25, armor=60, level=20, element='fire', resist={water=-30}, guarding=true}, {power=100, element='water', hits=3, true_damage=false, seed=40})
logic_define('resolve_attack', resolve_attack)
return 'E1 '..fmt(R1)..'\nE2 '..fmt(R2)"}

arguments:
{"code":"logic_define('nearest_tower', function(name)
  if not coreai_world_exists(name) then return 'none' end
  local p = coreai_world_pos(name)
  if p == nil then return 'none' end
  local bd = nil
  local any = false
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local t = coreai_world_pos('Tower' .. k)
    if t ~= nil then
      any = true
      local dx = p.x - t.x
      local dz = p.z - t.z
      local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
      if bd == nil or d < bd then bd = d end
    end
  end
  if not any then return 'none' end
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local t = coreai_world_pos('Tower' .. k)
    if t ~= nil then
      local dx = p.x - t.x
      local dz = p.z - t.z
      local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
      if d <= 1.01 * bd + 1e-9 then return 'Tower' .. k end
    end
  end
  return 'none'
end)

logic_define('wall_for_bearing', function(b)
  b = b % 360
  if b < 0 then b = b + 360 end
  local D = 15 * math.cos(math.rad(22.5))
  local half = math.deg(math.atan(1.5 / D))
  local function adiff(a, c)
    local d = math.abs(a - c) % 360
    if d > 180 then d = 360 - d end
    return d
  end
  if adiff(b, 347.5) <= half then return 'Gate_North' end
  if adiff(b, 167.5) <= half then return 'Gate_South' end
  local k = math.floor(((b - 10) % 360) / 45) + 1
  if k < 1 then k = 1 end
  if k > 8 then k = 8 end
  return 'Wall' .. k
end)
return 'slots defined'"}

arguments:
{"code":"local solve = function(grid, teleporters)
  if teleporters == nil then teleporters = {} end
  local R = #grid
  local C = #grid[1]
  local N = R * C * 4
  local dc, da, vis = {}, {}, {}
  for i = 1, N do dc[i] = math.huge; da[i] = math.huge end
  local sr, sc, gr, gc
  for r = 1, R do
    local row = grid[r]
    for c = 1, C do
      local ch = row:sub(c, c)
      if ch == 'S' then sr = r; sc = c
      elseif ch == 'G' then gr = r; gc = c end
    end
  end
  local function kidx(r, c, m) return ((r - 1) * C + (c - 1)) * 4 + m + 1 end
  local start = kidx(sr, sc, 0)
  dc[start] = 0; da[start] = 0
  local hc, ha, hi = {}, {}, {}
  local hs = 0
  local function push(cost, acts, idx)
    hs = hs + 1
    hc[hs] = cost; ha[hs] = acts; hi[hs] = idx
    local i = hs
    while i > 1 do
      local p = math.floor(i / 2)
      if hc[i] < hc[p] or (hc[i] == hc[p] and ha[i] < ha[p]) then
        hc[i], hc[p] = hc[p], hc[i]
        ha[i], ha[p] = ha[p], ha[i]
        hi[i], hi[p] = hi[p], hi[i]
        i = p
      else break end
    end
  end
  local function pop()
    local ci, ai, ii = hc[1], ha[1], hi[1]
    hc[1] = hc[hs]; ha[1] = ha[hs]; hi[1] = hi[hs]
    hs = hs - 1
    local i = 1
    while true do
      local l = i * 2
      local rr = l + 1
      local mm = i
      if l <= hs and (hc[l] < hc[mm] or (hc[l] == hc[mm] and ha[l] < ha[mm])) then mm = l end
      if rr <= hs and (hc[rr] < hc[mm] or (hc[rr] == hc[mm] and ha[rr] < ha[mm])) then mm = rr end
      if mm ~= i then
        hc[i], hc[mm] = hc[mm], hc[i]
        ha[i], ha[mm] = ha[mm], ha[i]
        hi[i], hi[mm] = hi[mm], hi[i]
        i = mm
      else break end
    end
    return ci, ai, ii
  end
  push(0, 0, start)
  local dirs = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}}
  while hs > 0 do
    local cost, acts, idx = pop()
    if (not vis[idx]) and dc[idx] == cost and da[idx] == acts then
      vis[idx] = true
      local z = idx - 1
      local m = z % 4
      local cell = math.floor(z / 4)
      local c = cell % C + 1
      local r = math.floor(cell / C) + 1
      if r == gr and c == gc then
        return {cost = cost, actions = acts}
      end
      local bm = m
      for d = 1, 4 do
        local nr = r + dirs[d][1]
        local nc = c + dirs[d][2]
        if nr >= 1 and nr <= R and nc >= 1 and nc <= C then
          local ch = grid[nr]:sub(nc, nc)
          local ok = true
          if ch == '#' then ok = false
          elseif ch == 'A' then ok = (bm % 2 == 1)
          elseif ch == 'B' then ok = (math.floor(bm / 2) % 2 == 1)
          elseif ch == '>' then ok = (d == 4)
          elseif ch == '<' then ok = (d == 3)
          elseif ch == '^' then ok = (d == 1)
          elseif ch == 'v' then ok = (d == 2) end
          if ok then
            local nm = bm
            if ch == 'a' then
              if bm % 2 == 0 then nm = bm + 1 end
            elseif ch == 'b' then
              if math.floor(bm / 2) % 2 == 0 then nm = bm + 2 end
            end
            local ncost = cost + (ch == '~' and 3 or 1)
            local nacts = acts + 1
            local ni = kidx(nr, nc, nm)
            if ncost < dc[ni] or (ncost == dc[ni] and nacts < da[ni]) then
              dc[ni] = ncost; da[ni] = nacts
              push(ncost, nacts, ni)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for t = 1, #teleporters do
        local tp = teleporters[t]
        if tp.fr == r and tp.fc == c then
          local nr, nc = tp.tr, tp.tc
          local ch = grid[nr]:sub(nc, nc)
          local ok = true
          if ch == '#' then ok = false
          elseif ch == 'A' then ok = (bm % 2 == 1)
          elseif ch == 'B' then ok = (math.floor(bm / 2) % 2 == 1) end
          if ok then
            local nm = bm
            if ch == 'a' then
              if bm % 2 == 0 then nm = bm + 1 end
            elseif ch == 'b' then
              if math.floor(bm / 2) % 2 == 0 then nm = bm + 2 end
            end
            local ncost = cost + tp.cost
            local nacts = acts + 1
            local ni = kidx(nr, nc, nm)
            if ncost < dc[ni] or (ncost == dc[ni] and nacts < da[ni]) then
              dc[ni] = ncost; da[ni] = nacts
              push(ncost, nacts, ni)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return {cost = -1, actions = -1}
end

local e1 = solve({'S~G','...'}, {})
local e2 = solve({'S.A.G','#.###','a....'}, {})
local e3 = solve({'S#G','.#.','...'}, {{fr=1,fc=1,tr=1,tc=3,cost=5}})
local e4 = solve({'S#G','.#.','...'}, {{fr=1,fc=1,tr=1,tc=3,cost=7}})
local e5 = solve({'S<G','...'}, {})

logic_define('route', function(grid, teleporters)
  return solve(grid, teleporters)
end)

return string.format('e1 %d/%d e2 %d/%d e3 %d/%d e4 %d/%d e5 %d/%d',
  e1.cost, e1.actions, e2.cost, e2.actions, e3.cost, e3.actions,
  e4.cost, e4.actions, e5.cost, e5.actions)"}
